usage: issuekit [-h] <command> ...

Manage API-backed issuekit trackers.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

commands:
  <command>
    info                Show issue tracker status.
    show                Read one active or completed issue without changing it.
    next-review         Read the next review-stage issue without changing issue state.
    add                 Register this checkout as a local worker.
    login               Authenticate to the API and cache the access token.
    logout              Log out of the API and remove the cached access token.
    author-guard        Inspect or clear the local author-session STOP guard.
    author              Create an active issue authored by an agent.
    dispatch            Direct an issue to a worker; use readdress to return it to the repo pool.
    edit                Edit an API-backed issue title, body, or priority.
    implement           Drive an agent to implement an active issue.
    negotiate           Drive a bounded cross-repository design negotiation.
    threads             Inspect negotiation thread status.
    proposal-check-request
                        Request evaluation of a pending proposal by a registered target worker.
    proposal-checks     Run one worker-side proposal-check polling cycle.
    validate            Validate API connectivity and issue response shape.
    complete            Complete an active issue.
    approve             Approve a review-stage issue.
    claim               Claim an issue for an assignee; defaults to the next eligible issue.
    claims              List active worker claims for this project.
    submit-review       Submit an issue for review.
    request-changes     Return an issue to its implementer with requested changes.
    queue               List active issues, optionally filtered by assignee.
    orphans             List implementing issues whose claiming worker is gone or silent.
    plan                Hold or release an issue in the implementation pool.
    readdress           Return a directed issue to the repo pool.
    reclaim             Return an orphaned implementing claim to the implement pool.
    repos               Maintain registered repository catalog entries.
    workers             List registered workers and their repo-level roles.
    runs                List and inspect agent runs.
    review              Drive an agent to review and record a decision on a review-stage issue.
    serve               Poll for eligible issues and run this checkout's worker agent.
    check-encoding      Check tracked files for encoding problems.
    protocol            Print the current handoff protocol.
    init                Install encoding and handoff scaffolding in the current repository.
    setup               Initialize repo MCP handoff scaffolding and print setup diagnostics.
    dev-tool            Maintain the global issuekit tool during local development.
    profile             Show the local project profile and, when available, stored remote ones.
    add-ref             Register a machine-local related repository ref.
    list-refs           List effective related repository refs.
    propose             Send a cross-repository proposal to a related repository.
    incoming            List incoming cross-repository proposals.
    outgoing            List proposals this project sent to a target project's inbox.
    adopt               Adopt an incoming proposal as a local active issue.
    discard             Discard a pending proposal: incoming by default, or sent when --to is
                        given.
    request             Route a PM request to owning project proposal inboxes.
    triage              Run one agent-backed triage-author cycle over the proposal inbox.

usage: issuekit author-guard [-h] [--json] <action> ...

Inspect, check, or clear the local author-session STOP guard.

positional arguments:
  <action>
    show      Show the current local author guards.
    check     Fail when a local issue guard is present.
    clear     Clear local author guards after handoff or human recovery.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      Print JSON output.

This command only manages the author-session STOP guard. It does not bypass the
mine-py server author-implementer guard, and it does not change
reviewer selection.

Separation-of-duties guard reference:

| Guard | Separates | Enforced by | Error string | Recovery |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Author-session STOP guard | The checkout/session that ran `author` -> the same checkout/session directly claiming, implementing, or submitting that authored issue. While an issue guard is recorded, pool claims from that checkout (`claim` without `--id`, `serve`) are blocked for every issue, because the next issue is unknown before the claim. Proposal guards record the handoff but do not block local issue lifecycle commands. | Client-side `issuekit.local.toml` `[[author_guards]]`, enforced by `enforce_no_author_guard`. `author-guard check` fails only for issue guards. Set `ISSUEKIT_ENFORCE_AUTHOR_HANDOFF=0` to skip this local enforcement while keeping the guard record visible; the same switch also relaxes the server author-implementer guard. | `Author-session guard blocks <action>: STOP_NOW: this checkout authored issue <ref>...` | Stop and hand off the authored issue, or use `issuekit implement <id> --agent <agent>` to orchestrate a distinct implementer session. After handoff, run `issuekit author-guard clear [--ref <ref>]`. Direct lifecycle commands can pass `--allow-author-session` only for human emergency recovery. |
| Server author-implementer guard | Issue author identity/session -> issue implementer identity/session. | mine-py API server; issuekit sends optional `ISSUEKIT_SESSION` audit tokens. Claims send `allow_self_implement` only when `ISSUEKIT_ENFORCE_AUTHOR_HANDOFF=0`, and the server then skips this guard. | `Issue #<id> was authored by <agent>. Same-name implementation is allowed only when both the authoring and implementing requests supply distinct session identities.` (code `forbidden_self_implement`) | Use a different implementer. Same-name delegation requires both author and implementer sessions to be recorded and distinct. `--allow-author-session` does not bypass this guard. |
| Distinct-reviewer guard | Issue implementer -> auto-selected reviewer. Author == reviewer is allowed by design. | Client-side reviewer resolution; the guard is always enforced. | `Distinct-reviewer guard blocks auto reviewer resolution: no configured reviewer is distinct from the issue implementer.` | Configure an assignee distinct from `issue.implementer`. |
| Server distinct-reviewer guard | Issue implementer identity/session -> reviewer identity/session. | mine-py API server (code `forbidden_self_review`) and client self-review checks in issuekit review. | `Issue #<n> was implemented by <agent>. Same-name review is allowed only when both the implementing and reviewing requests supply distinct session identities.` (code `forbidden_self_review`) | Use a different reviewer, or omit `reviewer` to route through the open review pool. Same-name review is allowed there only with distinct implementer and reviewer sessions; an implementer cannot explicitly assign itself as reviewer at submit time. |
| Work-branch guard | Shared checkout handoff work -> the configured branch for that repo. | Client-side `[tool.issuekit] work_branch` or top-level `issuekit.toml` `work_branch`, enforced by `enforce_work_branch` before claim and submit lifecycle mutations. | `Work-branch guard blocks <action>: checkout is on branch '<cur>' but work_branch is '<want>'. Switch to '<want>' or update config.` (a detached or unreadable HEAD reports `checkout branch could not be determined` instead) | Switch to the configured branch or update config. Lifecycle commands can pass `--allow-any-branch` only for human emergency recovery. |

Use this table to identify which guard fired before choosing a recovery path.

usage: issuekit author [-h] --title TITLE (--body BODY | --body-file BODY_FILE)
                       [--priority {high,medium,low}] --agent AGENT [--assign ASSIGN]
                       [--target-worker TARGET_WORKER] [--allow-unregistered-worker]
                       [--depends-on DEPENDS_ON] [--project PROJECT] [--direct-local-author]
                       [--origin-project ORIGIN_PROJECT] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE         Issue title.
  --body BODY           Inline issue body.
  --body-file BODY_FILE
                        File containing the issue body.
  --priority {high,medium,low}
                        Issue priority.
  --agent AGENT         Configured author agent.
  --assign ASSIGN       Optional implementer assignee.
  --target-worker TARGET_WORKER
                        Direct the issue to a registered worker.repo or worker.repo@machine.
  --allow-unregistered-worker
                        Allow directing to a worker that has not registered yet.
  --depends-on DEPENDS_ON
                        Attach an upstream dependency reference such as project#proposal:123.
  --project PROJECT     Explicit API project to author into when running outside a local issuekit
                        project root.
  --direct-local-author
                        Bypass the cross-project proposal preflight when deliberately creating a
                        local issue.
  --origin-project ORIGIN_PROJECT
                        Optional project where this request originated. If it differs from the
                        current project, use propose unless --direct-local-author is set.
  --json                Print JSON output.

usage: issuekit implement [-h] [--agent AGENT] [--model MODEL]
                          [--reasoning-effort REASONING_EFFORT] [--timeout-sec TIMEOUT_SEC]
                          [--follow] [--allow-no-changes] [--allow-missing-report]
                          [--allow-author-session] [--allow-any-branch] [--no-sync]
                          id

positional arguments:
  id                    Issue id to implement.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --agent AGENT         Configured agent name to run.
  --model MODEL         Optional model name passed to the agent.
  --reasoning-effort REASONING_EFFORT
                        Optional reasoning effort passed to the agent.
  --timeout-sec TIMEOUT_SEC
                        Hard timeout for the agent run in seconds.
  --follow              Emit a live heartbeat to stderr; it polls git status read-only without an
                        index lock and is safe for issues that rewrite the checkout.
  --allow-no-changes    Submit for review even when the agent produces no implementation diff.
  --allow-missing-report
                        Submit for review even when the agent wrote no implementer report.
  --allow-author-session
                        Override a local author-session STOP guard for human recovery.
  --allow-any-branch    Override the configured work_branch guard for human recovery.
  --no-sync             Skip the claim-time clean checkout and fast-forward sync guard.

usage: issuekit negotiate [-h] [--from-issue FROM_ISSUE] [--to TO] [--finalize THREAD_ID]
                          [--cancel THREAD_ID] [--provider-agent PROVIDER_AGENT]
                          [--consumer-agent CONSUMER_AGENT] [--counterpart-ref COUNTERPART_REF]
                          [--initiator-side {provider,consumer}] [--max-rounds MAX_ROUNDS]
                          [--mock] [--model MODEL] [--reasoning-effort REASONING_EFFORT]
                          [--timeout-sec TIMEOUT_SEC] [--author-agent AUTHOR_AGENT]
                          [--priority {high,medium,low}] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --from-issue FROM_ISSUE
                        Originating issue id.
  --to TO               Target project name.
  --finalize THREAD_ID  Create cross-linked implementation issues for an agreed thread.
  --cancel THREAD_ID    Cancel a negotiation thread.
  --provider-agent PROVIDER_AGENT
                        Configured agent representing the provider side.
  --consumer-agent CONSUMER_AGENT
                        Configured agent representing the consumer side.
  --counterpart-ref COUNTERPART_REF
                        Effective ref whose checkout the counterpart agent inspects.
  --initiator-side {provider,consumer}
                        Role held by the initiating checkout.
  --max-rounds MAX_ROUNDS
                        Maximum total agent turns, including the opening turn.
  --mock                Use the local mock negotiation store.
  --model MODEL         Optional model name passed to both agents.
  --reasoning-effort REASONING_EFFORT
                        Optional reasoning effort passed to both agents.
  --timeout-sec TIMEOUT_SEC
                        Hard timeout for each negotiation turn in seconds.
  --author-agent AUTHOR_AGENT
                        Author agent for issues created by --finalize.
  --priority {high,medium,low}
                        Priority for issues created by --finalize.
  --json                Print JSON output.

usage: issuekit serve [-h] [--agent AGENT] [--model MODEL] [--reasoning-effort REASONING_EFFORT]
                      [--interval INTERVAL] [--heartbeat-interval HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL]
                      [--max-heartbeat-failures MAX_HEARTBEAT_FAILURES]
                      [--max-run-failures MAX_RUN_FAILURES] [--priority {high,medium,low}]
                      [--once] [--triage] [--review | --proposal-checks]
                      [--proposal-check-limit PROPOSAL_CHECK_LIMIT] [--max-issues MAX_ISSUES]
                      [--timeout-sec TIMEOUT_SEC] [--allow-any-branch] [--no-sync]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --agent AGENT         Configured agent name to run.
  --model MODEL         Optional model name applied to every agent launched by this serve loop;
                        use per-agent config for mixed-agent model selection.
  --reasoning-effort REASONING_EFFORT
                        Optional reasoning effort applied to every agent launched by this serve
                        loop; use per-agent config for mixed-agent effort selection.
  --interval INTERVAL   Idle poll interval in seconds.
  --heartbeat-interval HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
                        Worker heartbeat interval in seconds; overrides
                        worker_heartbeat_interval_sec.
  --max-heartbeat-failures MAX_HEARTBEAT_FAILURES
                        Stop gracefully after this many consecutive heartbeat failures (default:
                        0, unlimited).
  --max-run-failures MAX_RUN_FAILURES
                        Stop after this many consecutive failed runs (default: 3, 0: unlimited).
  --priority {high,medium,low}
                        Priority filter for claim-next.
  --once                Attempt at most one claim and then exit.
  --triage              Auto-adopt matching incoming proposals before each claim attempt.
  --review              Poll the review pool and run this checkout's reviewer agent.
  --proposal-checks     Poll pending proposal checks addressed to this worker.
  --proposal-check-limit PROPOSAL_CHECK_LIMIT
                        Maximum proposal checks to evaluate per polling cycle.
  --max-issues MAX_ISSUES
                        Exit after this many successful submissions.
  --timeout-sec TIMEOUT_SEC
                        Hard timeout for each agent run in seconds.
  --allow-any-branch    Override the configured work_branch guard for human recovery.

options:

  --changed             Scan only files changed in the working tree (or relative to --base)
                        instead of every tracked file. Cuts the fixed per-run cost on no-change or
                        small-change runs; use a full scan (the default) in CI.
  --base BASE           With --changed, scan files that differ from this git ref (e.g.
                        origin/main) instead of only uncommitted working-tree changes.
